Question: Indore Municipal Corporation ke under kitne wards aate hain? (How many wards are there in Indore?)
Answer: Indore mein total 85 wards hain, jo 22 zones mein grouped hain. Ye IMC Saathi ke apne verified zone database se hai (isi se ward number se zone aur zonal officer ka contact nikalta hai), isliye ye number reliable hai.

Question: Indore ke mayor kaun hain? (Who is the Mayor of Indore?)
Answer: Indore ke current mayor Pushyamitra Bhargav hain (BJP), 2022 municipal election ke baad se. Ye ek elected political position hai jo samay ke saath badal sakti hai — agar bahut zaroori ho toh official IMC website ya news se latest confirm kar lein.

Question: Indore kis state mein hai aur MP ki capital hai kya? (Which state is Indore in — is it the capital of MP?)
Answer: Indore Madhya Pradesh mein hai, aur Madhya Pradesh ka sabse bada shehar hai — lekin MP ki capital nahi hai (state capital Bhopal hai). Indore ko state ki 'commercial/financial capital' kaha jaata hai.

Question: Indore kis liye famous hai? (What is Indore famous for?)
Answer: Sabse zyada: Swachh Survekshan (Bharat ka national cleanliness survey) mein baar-baar India ka sabse saaf shehar (cleanest city) — 2024-25 survey mein 8vi baar. Iske alawa: IIT Indore aur IIM Indore ki wajah se ek bada education hub, pharma/auto manufacturing aur trading ka commercial center, aur Sarafa Bazaar/Chappan Dukan jaise street-food destinations ke liye mashhoor.

Question: Indore ka history/itihaas kya hai? (What is the history of Indore?)
Answer: Indore ek purana trading town tha jo Maratha Holkar dynasty ke shasan mein ubhara — Rani Ahilyabai Holkar (18vi sadi) ka naam Indore ke itihaas mein sabse zyada jud a hai, unke shasan ko ek golden period maana jaata hai (Indore airport unhi ke naam par hai). 1818 mein British paramountcy ke baad ek princely state raha, 1947 mein azaadi ke baad Madhya Pradesh ka hissa bana.
